app.name: SmogShift
app.tagline: Smog-smart days for your family, with the impact counted in cigarettes and CO₂.
app.footer: Air data: Open-Meteo (CAMS forecast). Summaries: Groq AI, written only from the numbers shown. 1 cigarette ≈ breathing 22 µg/m³ of PM2.5 for a day (Berkeley Earth). Not medical advice.

form.heading: Plan a smog-smart day
form.intro: Tell us a little about your household. Nothing is stored.
form.cityHint: English spelling works best, e.g. Pune, Delhi, Mumbai.
form.groupsHint: Tick everyone who is more sensitive to polluted air.
form.heating: How do you heat your home or water?

results.heading: Today in {city}
results.summaryAi: Written by AI using only the numbers on this page.
results.summaryFallback: Air in {city} is {category} right now (US AQI {aqi}, PM2.5 {pm25} µg/m³). Most important today: {top}.
results.actionsHeading: What to do today, most important first

impact.streetCo2: You + {neighbours} neighbours: {n} kg CO₂ saved per week
impact.streetHouseholds: You + {neighbours} neighbours: {n} fewer smoke sources on your street

exercise-indoors.title: Move today's workout indoors
exercise-indoors.detail: The air is too polluted for exercise outside. You breathe 2–3× more air when active, so work out indoors with the windows closed.

exercise-clean-hour.title: Exercise at {time}
exercise-clean-hour.detail: If you exercise outside, go at {time}, when PM2.5 is forecast to drop to {pm25} µg/m³.

protect-sensitive.title: Protect the most vulnerable at home
protect-sensitive.detail: At home: {groups}. Keep their outdoor time short, keep reliever medicines handy, and see a doctor if breathing gets harder.

wear-n95.title: Wear an N95 mask outdoors
wear-n95.detail: A well-fitted N95 or FFP2 mask blocks most fine dust. Cloth and surgical masks stop far less.

errands-clean-hour.title: Do errands around {time}
errands-clean-hour.detail: Shift market trips, walks and school pick-ups to around {time}, when PM2.5 is forecast at {pm25} µg/m³.

short-trips.title: Keep outdoor trips short
short-trips.detail: No cleaner hour is forecast for the rest of today, so combine errands into one short trip and avoid busy roads.

ventilate-now.title: Air out your home now
ventilate-now.detail: The air is clean right now. Open windows for 10–15 minutes to flush out cooking smoke and dust.

close-windows.title: Keep windows closed during smog
close-windows.detail: Shut windows and doors during smoggy hours, and air the house out briefly at the cleanest hour of the day.

run-purifier.title: Run your purifier overnight
run-purifier.detail: Run it on high in the bedroom with the door closed while everyone sleeps.

diy-purifier.title: Build a ₹1,500 DIY purifier
diy-purifier.detail: Tape a MERV-13 filter to a box fan (a Corsi–Rosenthal box) and run it in the bedroom at night with the door closed.

avoid-indoor-smoke.title: Cut smoke inside your home
avoid-indoor-smoke.detail: On smog days skip incense, candles and mosquito coils, use the exhaust fan when frying, and mop instead of sweeping.

switch-commute.title: Take the {target} instead of the {mode}
switch-commute.detail: Your {km} km {mode} commute adds exhaust to the same streets you breathe. The {target} is cleaner for everyone.

switch-heating.title: Stop burning {fuel}
switch-heating.detail: Burning {fuel} is one of the biggest winter smog sources. Switch to an electric heater or heat pump, and never burn rubbish.

no-burning.title: Stop leaf and rubbish burning
no-burning.detail: Compost leaves instead of burning them, and ask your housing society to stop open burning or report it to the municipal body.

schedule.heading: Reshuffle my day
schedule.intro: Type your plans in your own words. AI reads them; our code moves flexible outdoor tasks to the cleanest hours of today's forecast.
schedule.label: Your day
schedule.hint: For example: 9am school drop 20 min, 11am market 1 hr, 6pm walk 45 min.
schedule.n95: The air is still unhealthy then, so wear an N95.

audit.heading: Check a room for pollution sources
audit.intro: Take or choose a photo of your kitchen, bedroom or living room. AI looks for things that pollute the air indoors.
audit.label: Room photo
audit.hint: Your photo is shrunk and stripped of location data on this device before upload, and it is never stored.
audit.none: No obvious pollution sources spotted. Still: air out your home at the cleanest hour, and skip incense and candles on smog days.
audit.previewAlt: Preview of the photo you chose
